sets.name: lift
sets.note: The arm lifts from hanging to 150°. Expect: the ball stays in the socket, no muscle folds or enters bone, the bursa stays on the tendon.

sets.name: zoom
sets.note: The camera goes from Shoulder to Tendon in small steps. Expect: nothing pops in or out, each part keeps its place and size, and a part that fades does so in place.
